source.attribution: This file contains information from the Getty Union List of Artist Names (ULAN), made available by the J. Paul Getty Trust under the Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) 1.0, http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1.0/. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
source.notes: Biography descriptions are prose ('Chinese calligrapher, active ca. 1023-1056'), so the date must be found inside running text: these entries measure the salvage path. The expected years are ULAN's estStart/estEnd, which are deliberately padded estimates (an active period is widened to plausible lifetime bounds), so since 2026-10-14 the expected years are read from the string itself and the estimate is kept in sourceExpectation. Sixty biographies from each of six bands of estimated start year (before 1400, then by century to 1900 and after).
